title: fix: validate invalid route logLevel at registration
prompt:
## Description
- validate route/plugin `logLevel` values during route registration
- throw `FST_ERR_ROUTE_LOG_LEVEL_INVALID` instead of failing at request time
- document the new error code and custom log-level behavior
- add regression coverage for invalid route `logLevel`

## Testing
- `node --test test/logger/options.test.js`
- `node --test test/internals/errors.test.js`
- `npm run lint:eslint -- lib/route.js lib/errors.js test/logger/options.test.js test/internals/errors.test.js types/errors.d.ts`
- `npm run lint:markdown -- docs/Reference/Routes.md docs/Reference/Errors.md`

Fixes #6124
